if you're available, you'll need to pick up the supplies at [location] first before heading to [destination]. once on site, it is important that you neutralize all the hostiles before completing delivery of the supplies.

additionally, to help prevent an incident like this happening again, we believe that having you destroy the xenothreat servers at [location1] would act as a further deterrent.

thanks,
 
lima endicott
